captions.detailed: An olive-green mountain artillery gun featuring a split-trail carriage frame with black rear spades. It has a dark grey cylindrical barrel that pivots vertically on a central trunnion axle. The entire assembly is mounted on two large, brown-spoked wheels with black outer rims, which rotate continuously on their axle hubs.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated mountain artillery gun model in CadQuery. The design should feature a dark green split-trail carriage base, a dark grey elevating barrel mounted on trunnions, and two rotating spoked wheels with a brown wooden texture and black rims.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base carriage part using several box primitives to form the frame and spade blocks. The barrel part is built from concentric cylinder primitives for the main tube, muzzle, breech, and pivot shaft. Two wheel parts are created by combining a central cylinder hub, thin box spokes arranged in a radial pattern, and an outer cylinder rim. Revolute and continuous joints are then declared to link the barrel and wheels to the main carriage.
